The '''massacre at Terrina Square''' took place around [[2 ABY/Legends|2.5 ABY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quellor/Legends|Quellor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] were initially ordered to refrain from using [[Death/Legends|deadly]] force, they ultimately cleared [[Terrina Square]] by killing hundreds of peaceful demonstrators who had been protesting the atrocities perpetrated by the Empire in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], as well as calling for an end to [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] such as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. The massacre was then promptly censored from all regulated [[Media/Legends|media]] outlets by the Empire's [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]].

==Prelude==
The [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] saw the destruction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Due to their humiliating defeat, the Empire, which ruled much of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], let go of all its pretense of being benign and began to respond to any manner of resistance with fearsome might.<ref name="RES" /> Nevertheless, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quellor/Legends|Quellor]] became a site of peaceful anti-Imperial rallies in the battle's aftermath.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|62|Quellor}}</ref>

Almost [[3 ABY/Legends|three years after]] the battle, as the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Rebels and the Empire intensified in 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], hundreds of citizens of many [[Species/Legends|species]] gathered at Quellor's [[Terrina Square]] to protest reported Imperial atrocities in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], as well as to rally for the banning of [[Weapon/Legends|superweapons]] similar to the destroyed [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="RES" />

==Burning Emperor and blaster fire==
[[File:Compnor_logo.svg|thumb|right|300px|Censorship by the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order (logo depicted) came into effect after the massacre of the peaceful protestors at Terrina Square.]]
While the protest was peaceful, the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Quellor, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Toggan]], [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to oversee the demonstration and maintain order; Toggan specifically told [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] not to employ [[Death/Legends|deadly]] force unless he said otherwise. However, when the crowd at Terrina Square [[Fire/Legends|burned]] a facsimile of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to demonstrate their disapproval of Imperial policies, the troopers pushed through the demonstrator lines and opened fire with their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], clearing a path toward the burning effigy. Whether they acted on their own accord or on orders from someone more influential than Toggan,<ref name="RES" /> the stormtroopers' actions resulted in extensive civilian casualties.<ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
For thirty [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], the massacre at Terrina Square was major news, yet at the end of the [[Standard day/Legends|day]], the Empire's [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] censored further news of the subject under all the regulated [[Media/Legends|media]] outlets.<ref name="RES" /> Emperor Palpatine was killed and the Empire was fractured by the Rebellion with the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] on the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] about one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] later.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The massacre at Terrina Square was first mentioned in ''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]'', a [[2001]] supplement to the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="RES" />
